data.species_model: Two distinct generic metal ions form only 1:1 ML complexes with the deprotonated free ligand L. Unbound ligand comprises HL and L;only HL<=>H+ +L protonation is included. Fixed-pH supporting reservoirs hold the given pH independently of binding. No hydrolysis,precipitation,mixed complexes or ligand degradation.
data.constant_boundary: These are explicitly illustrative concentration-scale constants for a controlled separation model,not measured constants for an identified real metal/ligand pair. Both beta values refer to free deprotonated L,not to total unbound ligand.
data.decision: Admit conditions meeting BOTH target recovery and background carryover limits. Among admitted conditions choose the highest target complexed fraction;source condition ID breaks an exact tie.

provenance.kind: controlled computational analytical study, not experimental measurements
provenance.generation: Controlled computational input table for the stated study; not experimental measurements. Authentic source inputs are documented separately when present.
